interpretation.adjusted_p_status: computed at family closure (DR-2); not available at freeze
interpretation.basis: Raw p = 0.1349 > 0.05 (raw, not family-adjusted). A Holm-adjusted p is never below its raw p, so the adjusted p at family closure also exceeds 0.05 and the registered outcome is inconclusive; the adjusted value itself is reported at closure.

branch_B.scope: A labelled diagnostic, not a finding of absence or equivalence (H1 section 10).

interpretation.decision_rule: DR-E1: reject when the Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 at family closure (section 10); no rejection is declared from the raw p alone

statements.inconclusive: The E1 comparison did not detect an unusually large pre-onset change under the registered surrogate model.
statements.reject: The observed mean pre-onset change in annual data was unusually large relative to the registered fitted constant-AR(2) surrogate procedure.

interpretation.text: The E1 comparison did not detect an unusually large pre-onset change under the registered surrogate model.

report_quantities.decision: DR-E1 uses the Holm-adjusted p at family closure (section 10)
